name: SQLite file
summary: A database that lives in a single file on your server's disk, with no separate service to run.

free_plan_covers.note: Free and public domain. The only cost is the disk it lives on.

portability.note: Standard SQL in one file you can copy anywhere.

storage_model.note: Reads and writes an ordinary file on the disk of the machine running your app.

data_model.note: Tables and SQL, like Postgres or MySQL.

realtime_built_in.note: No way to push changes to browsers; your own server would have to do it.

serverless_friendly.note: Needs a disk shared by every request, which serverless functions do not have.

mobile_sdk.note: A phone app cannot reach a file on your server; it would go through your own API.

setup.step: Add a SQLite library to your server code and choose a file path on a permanent disk.

builder_notes: Keep the database file on a persistent disk and back it up; it is lost on hosts without one.
